what: AI tools that forget context every session force users to re-explain preferences and workflows repeatedly (top complaint in analysis of 500 Reddit AI tool posts: 34% about memory, 19% about re-explaining context).
why_us: Persistent memory / personal AI context layer is a clear unmet demand; people quantify time waste (91 hours/year). High willingness to pay for agents that remember across sessions.
engagement: Indie Hackers post with analysis of 500 complaints

what: Rescue service for vibe-coded / AI-generated apps that ship broken: exposed keys, security holes, unmaintainable code, failed payments. Users spend thousands on platforms like Base44 ($3k wasted) and Atoms then abandon projects.
why_us: Non-technical founders hit a wall after MVP generation. Explicit gap for human review, security fixes, and production hardening. Recurring pain with real money already spent.
engagement: Multiple 1-star reviews detailing $1k+ losses and unusable output

what: Indie SaaS Reachlee crossed $1,800 MRR (from ~$1,500 a few days earlier), MCP integration live. Consistent public updates showing growth.
why_us: Validates demand for AI-powered tools with clear distribution; solo/small-team trajectory to $10k MRR target.

what: Subscription that lets users trial SaaS products locked behind 'Contact Sales' for sales demos and competitive analysis.
why_us: Sales teams and builders want hands-on access without gatekeeping; useful for product research and agent-driven demos.
engagement: 10 likes, 5 replies (niche but specific payment intent)

what: Mobile-first field inspection / construction app with photo+GPS tagging and simple forms. Desktop platforms dominate; field workers stuck with paper or poor mobile experiences. Analysis of 39k complaints highlights this as high-severity gap.
why_us: Boring industry with real workflow pain, low competition on the narrow use-case, willingness to pay $29/user/month from subcontractors.

what: Always-on AI ad creative team: monitors Meta/TikTok ads, detects dying winners, generates and tests variations overnight, scales winners. Inspired by Higgsfield + Creatify ($9M ARR).
why_us: Clear monetization path ($99-249/mo tiers), distribution via ad library outreach. Addresses creative fatigue pain.
revenue: Potential $99-249/mo; comparable tools hit multi-M ARR
engagement: 15 likes, detailed build outline with cost estimates
